description: Election Commission - Declare that A. M. C. K. Abeykon and H. P. J. Walgampaya as members of the Yatinuwara Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in a local government body (Yatinuwara Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including declarations of elected members to fill vacancies caused by death and non-attendance of meetings. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes and declarations related to local government elections.
